leaves.name: javanpeykarPrintedMapHF
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-rebase: Javanpeykar, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014) Thm 1.1.1 in printed form at X = X0 x_K Qbar (X0 a smooth proper geometrically connected curve over a number field K, Qbar = AlgebraicClosure K): X projective (closed immersion into a projective space over Qbar), Jac(X) = W an abelian variety over Qbar representing Pic^0_{X/Qbar} with the tensor group law, V a model of W over K (V_Qbar = W), g = genusBar X = dim H^1(X, O_X), beta : X -> P^1_Qbar = Proj Qbar[X0,X1] a Belyi map of degree d (IsBelyiMap), h = height-fix's printed stable height ZInQ.HeightFix.IsPrintedStableHeight of V (sound archimedean metric defined chart by chart; Neron model semistable over the residue fields k(p)): h <= 13*10^6 * g * d^5. javanpeykar-fix's JavanpeykarPrintedMap verbatim over height-fix's height (JavanpeykarRebase.javanpeykarPrintedMap_of_fix: implied by it given T35 and Stacks 04KV). Replaces javanpeykarBound (JavanpeykarRebase.javanpeykarBound_of_printed_rebase, with constantFieldExtensionUnramifiedFinite, mumfordTorsionAlgClosed and uniformizationLeafAll_proof for T35, and height-fix's glue semiAbelianDescendsPerfect).

leaves.name: constantFieldExtensionUnramifiedFinite
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-rebase: Stichtenoth, Algebraic Function Fields and Codes (2nd ed., GTM 254), Thm 3.6.3(a), for a FINITE constant field extension, with Stichtenoth's standing hypothesis that K is the full constant field of F: for F/K an algebraic function field (char 0) and L/K finite with F (x)_K L = FL (bijective productMap), every place of FL/L (valuation subring w containing L) is unramified over its restriction to F: a generator of the maximal ideal of w cap F generates that of w. The algebraic case used by the consumer (L = Kbar) is proved from it (JavanpeykarRebase.full_of_finite); finite_of_full gives the converse.
